findings.evidence: Repository grep finds these declarations used only within `Dissipative/Basic.lean`; external code uses the high-level `IsMDissipative.resolvent` declarations at lines 403–430.
findings.fix: Make this construction chain private (or place it in a private namespace), exposing only the reusable `IsMDissipative.resolvent` API.
findings.issue: The implementation chain `smulSubLinear`, `coe_smulSubLinear`, `smulSubEquiv`, `smul_sub_symm_smulSubEquiv`, `norm_symm_smulSubEquiv_le`, and `resolventOfBijective` plus its helper lemmas is public although it only constructs the m-dissipative resolvent and the existing private Neumann-series helper.

findings.evidence: The only equality with the exponential is the local `have h` at lines 211–213; grep finds no exported `yosidaSemigroup_*` API.
findings.fix: Add a characteristic `@[simp] yosidaSemigroup_apply` theorem (and, if downstream generator reasoning needs it, a theorem identifying its underlying strongly continuous semigroup with `ofBounded`).
findings.issue: `yosidaSemigroup` has no public application theorem, so consumers cannot establish `yosidaSemigroup t = exp (t • yosidaApprox)` without unfolding its body; this also obstructs reuse of the `ofBounded` generator/domain API without definitional unfolding.

findings.evidence: Both rewrite a headed construction to a strictly simpler expression; the parallel semigroup-resolvent `resolventLeftInv` declarations are `@[simp]` at `Resolvent/Identity.lean:97` and `:242`, and `ofBounded_apply` is `@[simp]` at `BoundedGenerator/Basic.lean:105`.
findings.issue: The pointwise normal form `yosidaApprox_apply` is not tagged `@[simp]`; likewise the inverse normal form `IsMDissipative.resolventLeftInv` at `Dissipative/Basic.lean:420` lacks the annotation used by the parallel resolvent API.

summary: The public surface exposes proof machinery while leaving the principal semigroup without a usable characteristic API. Normal-form lemmas also lack expected simplifier annotations.
